summary: Mobile responsive fix for StaysSearchBar validated on iPhone 14 (393x852) and desktop (1440x900). All 5 specified test scenarios passed. No regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: StaysSearchBar.jsx (~80 lines) is clean — well-commented, separate pickers, good use of data-testid. Mobile pill collapses cleanly with `hidden sm:block` + `flex-1 min-w-0`. The redundant `rounded-l-full sm:rounded-l-full rounded-full sm:rounded-r-none` on line 35 could be simplified to `rounded-full sm:rounded-l-full sm:rounded-r-none` (the duplicate `sm:rounded-l-full` is a no-op) — purely cosmetic, no functional impact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile fix for /stays search pill is verified. Where input ~277px on 393px viewport, StayType/When segments hidden via `hidden sm:block`, Filters btn icon-only on mobile, full 3-segment layout intact on desktop. Filters modal correctly surfaces Dates (mobile-only) and stay-type chips so no functionality is lost on mobile. QuickChips row scrollable and functional.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: at 390px, the 3-segment pill divided horizontal space ~equally giving Where only ~69px, clipping 'Anywhere' placeholder. Fix: applied `hidden sm:block` to Stay Type + When segments and the two `w-px` dividers in StaysSearchBar.jsx so on <640px viewports the pill collapses to Where (full width) + icon-only Filters btn. Validated: Where width grew from ~69px to 277px on iPhone 14.
